products.product_description: Kvas, a fermented non-alcoholic drink, packaged in a gallon plastic jugs The label is read in parts: "***Mom's Kvas***1 Gallon***Ingredients: Water, Cane Sugar, Instant Coffee, Yeast, Apple Cider***Home made to your taste with Low Calories! Keep Refrigerated to Prevent from perishing***Mom's Delicious Kitchen, LLC, Portland, OR 97266***".
products.code_info: No codes were on the packages.
products.reason_for_recall: Kvas, a fermented non-alcoholic drink, due to bulging. A hole was punched to the lids of the gallon plastic jugs to prevent the plastic jugs from bulging. The package integrity was compromised.
